officialSendingAgency.name: Department of Migrant Workers (DMW)
officialSendingAgency.address: Blas F. Ople Building, Ortigas Avenue corner EDSA, Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) as the Philippine sending agency and lists its Mandaluyong reception office.
HRD Korea currently lists the 11th point-system recruitment in Philippines_Manufacturing as a Regular CBT route, but registration, test and result dates are undecided.
The current official DMW EPS portal states that no registration is currently open while displaying a qualification/document preparation snapshot.
The March 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK is a separate returning-worker route and is explicitly excluded from this Regular Manufacturing Country Pack.
2025 Regular Manufacturing advisories are retained only as prior-cycle workflow-shape evidence for skills, medical and roster steps.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use the current DMW EPS portal qualification snapshot only as a pre-check. The next Regular Manufacturing notice must control the final age window and any cycle-specific eligibility conditions.

stages.title: Regular EPS-TOPIK registration
stages.action: No Regular EPS-TOPIK registration is currently open on the official DMW portal. HRD Korea lists the 11th point-system recruitment in Philippines_Manufacturing, but registration/test/result dates are still undecided.

stages.title: Regular EPS-TOPIK fee
stages.action: Do not pay any test fee until DMW publishes the Regular Manufacturing registration notice. The US$24 fee in the March 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK advisory belongs to the special returning-worker route and must not be reused here.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Prepare to follow the identity-verification requirements in the next Regular Manufacturing notice. KEP does not infer a biometric step from the Special EPS route or the 2025 cycle.

stages.title: Registration file preparation
stages.action: The current DMW portal asks applicants to prepare a recent passport-sized JPG photo and a scanned passport JPG. Treat these as the current portal snapshot and recheck when Regular registration opens.

stages.title: Exam schedule / admission preparation
stages.action: Wait for the official Regular Manufacturing test-date notice and admission instructions. Current HRD Korea schedule fields for the 11th recruitment are undecided.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — Regular Manufacturing
stages.action: The 11th point-system Regular Manufacturing route is registered in HRD Korea, but its current registration, test and result dates remain undecided. Do not substitute the 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK schedule.

stages.title: Skills Test / Job Capacity Assessment
stages.action: Regular Philippines Manufacturing uses a point-based selection flow with a second-round skills/job-capacity stage, but KEP has not verified the current 2026 Regular schedule or scoring notice. 2025 material is workflow-shape evidence only.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: For the Regular route, final selection requires the current point-system notice and current-cycle results. Do not reuse 2025 quotas, cutoffs or dates as 2026 Regular facts.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Philippines psychology stage is asserted for the current Regular route. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.authority: DMW / DOH-accredited provider as officially instructed
stages.action: The 2025 Regular Manufacturing process required medical examination after the official final-pass announcement at a DOH-accredited clinic. That is prior-cycle workflow evidence only; wait for the current Regular notice before using exact medical instructions.

stages.title: Job-roster candidate file
stages.action: The 2025 Regular Manufacturing final-pass advisory shows a post-selection candidate-file/medical submission stage, but its documents, links and timing are not current 2026 Regular rules. Wait for the current DMW advisory.

stages.title: EPS Job Roster
stages.action: Passing selection does not guarantee employment. A worker becomes eligible for the EPS Job Roster only through the official process after the required current-cycle steps.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS process. DMW is the Philippine sending agency; a private broker cannot guarantee a Korean employer selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow the current DMW EPS advisory for the SLC and subsequent requirements. No private intermediary can legitimately guarantee or alter an SLC.

stages.title: Post-SLC Philippines requirements
stages.action: Follow only current DMW advisories for training, medical follow-up, visa documents, fees and departure preparation. KEP has not yet promoted exact 2026 Regular downstream rules.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current DMW/Korean-mission instructions for visa processing. Exact 2026 Regular Manufacturing checklist and fees are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure preparation / training
stages.action: Use the current DMW advisory for any mandatory pre-departure training/orientation. Exact 2026 Regular cohort instructions are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Final medical/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow the current DMW departure advisory if a final medical or health recheck is required.

stages.title: Official departure to Korea
stages.action: Travel only after official DMW/EPS contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete and an official departure plan is issued.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
